title: Pointwise tilt bound 1 − G ≤ 2(1 − |ξ(β)|) under radial tangency
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep of dimension 2 in ℝ^P (U = univ), μ := R.measure, T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x with orthogonal projection p_{T_x}. Let Q be a linear subspace with dim Q = 2 and orthogonal projection π, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, 2) with β(v) = ⟨a, v₀⟩⟨e, v₁⟩ − ⟨a, v₁⟩⟨e, v₀⟩ for all v : Fin 2 → ℝ^P. Assume p_{T_x}x = x for μ-a.e. x. Put Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a and G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|². Then (i) G(x) ≤ 1 for every x with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0; (ii) for μ-a.e. x: |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ 1, and if ⟨x, a⟩ > 0 then 1 − 2(1 − |ξ(x)(β)|) ≤ G(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (β : Covector (Euclid P) 2), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ v : Fin 2 → Euclid P, β v = inner ℝ a (v 0) * inner ℝ e (v 1) - inner ℝ a (v 1) * inner ℝ e (v 0)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → (∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, |R.orient x β| ≤ 1 ∧ (0 < inner ℝ x a → 1 - 2 * (1 - |R.orient x β|) ≤ ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)
